name: kaiju
description: Kaiju — application web de participation interactive en temps réel pour conférences, cours et ateliers (local-first).

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: node scripts/assert-supported-node.mjs && npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.seed:demo: node scripts/assert-supported-node.mjs && npm run build:shared && npm run seed:demo --workspace @kaiju/server
scripts.dev:server: node scripts/assert-supported-node.mjs && npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace @kaiju/server
scripts.dev:client: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace @kaiju/client
